_comment: Quotes already used, to prevent repeats. The authoritative check is column B of Sheet2 (read it live); this file is a convenience mirror. Append every new quote here when you add cards.
quotes: Between stimulus and response there is a space. In that space is our power to choose our response.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
The curious paradox is that when I accept myself just as I am, then I can change.
The childhood shows the man, as morning shows the day.
In a very real sense we have two minds, one that thinks and one that feels.
Emotional intelligence is the single biggest predictor of performance in the workplace.
Inside every older person is a younger person wondering what happened.
We never really grow up, we only learn how to act in public.
Every man is a damn fool for at least five minutes every day; wisdom consists in not exceeding the limit.
Owning our story and loving ourselves through that process is the bravest thing we'll ever do.
Feelings are much like waves: we can't stop them from coming, but we can choose which to surf.
You don't have to attend every argument you're invited to.
It is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men.
Your children are not your children. They are the sons and daughters of Life's longing for itself.
